p9_b0.ocr: The stakeholder analysis reveals the following: for Physicians, the knowledge of stakeholder regarding the initiative is Medium, their interest in the issue (willingness to initiate or lead) is Low, their influence/power is High, level of engagement is Involve, the impact of the issue on the actor is High, and the proposed engagement method is Increase ownership/workshops/meetings. Nurses have a Low knowledge of stakeholder regarding the initiative, a Medium interest in the issue, Medium influence/power, an Involve level of engagement, Medium impact of the issue, and proposed engagement method is Workshops/meetings. For Patient/patient's family, knowledge is Medium, interest is High, influence/power is Low, engagement is Involve, impact is High, with proposed engagement method being One on one meetings. Pharmacy stakeholders have Low knowledge, Low interest, High influence/power, an Involve engagement level, Medium impact, and the engagement method is Electronic system. The Accounting department shows Low knowledge, Low interest, Medium influence/power, a Collaborate engagement level, Medium impact, and proposed engagement method is Electronic system. Medical records have Medium knowledge, Medium interest, Medium influence/power, a Collaborate engagement level, Medium impact, and proposed engagement method is Electronic system.

p9_b1.ocr: In Table 2, the Age at participation for BRCA1 mutation carriers is 40.2 (8.1), for BRCA2 mutation carriers is 39.5 (13.7), for non-carriers with family history of breast cancer is 46.3 (11.1), and for non-carriers with early-onset breast cancer is 38.8 (13.1). The table also shows that among postmenopausal women, BRCA1 mutation carriers are 40 (23.8), BRCA2 mutation carriers are 13 (24.1), non-carriers with family history are 112 (44.8), and non-carriers with early-onset breast cancer are 19 (17.4). Current drinkers in BRCA1 mutation carriers are 32 (19.1), in BRCA2 mutation carriers are 17 (31.5), in non-carriers with family history are 42 (16.8), and in non-carriers with early-onset breast cancer are 45 (41.3). Current smokers include 7 (4.2) in BRCA1 mutation carriers, 5 (9.3) in BRCA2 mutation carriers, 4 (1.6) in non-carriers with family history, and 2 (1.8) in non-carriers with early-onset breast cancer. For BMI ≥ 25 Kg/m2, BRCA1 mutation carriers have 28 (16.8), BRCA2 mutation carriers have 8 (14.8), non-carriers with family history are 46 (18.4), and non-carriers with early-onset breast cancer are 23 (21.1).
